name: [HARD +1800 SUMMIT!] Mount Kawah Terjun 🌊
desc:
Mount Kawah Terjun V2 x Ledolla!
✨ One For All! ✨

Welcome to Mount Kawah Terjun, a mountain that is Easy and Friendly for New Players, inspired by Curug Cimahi & Sky Island. 

Main Features:

🎮 4 Game Modes
Super Easy Mode gives 50 Summits, Easy Mode 100, Normal Mode 200, & Insane Mode 6000— relax or challenge your adrenaline.

⛰️ Various exciting obstacles that will never let you get bored!

✨ Various Auras that you can collect!

🏆 Various interesting Titles that you can earn, up to 15 million times Reaching the Summit!

💎 VIP Access with various benefits for Players.

🧗 Carry System, bring many of your friends along! 🤝

🗺️ 20 Checkpoints. Continue your expedition anytime without having to start from the beginning.

📸 Lots of View & Photo Spots, capture beautiful moments at the base of the crater.

🌿 Natural Atmosphere with lava areas, trees, cliffs, and stunning waterfalls.

Feel the thrill of conquering the trail to the waterfall, enjoy all of the spectacular scenery 🌠
